content.text:
All three renders are complete and verified. 

**Deliverables** (in the working folder): `portrait.png` (1080×1350), `wide.png` (1200×1000), `sky.png` (300×600) — plus the sources `build.js`, `portrait.html`, `wide.html`, `sky.html`.

**How it scales:** one template, rendered three times with `html{font-size: s*10px}` and every dimension in `rem`, so the whole design is exactly 1× / 0.85× / 0.28×. Bands (photo, red CTA) are `width:100%` so they stay edge-to-edge at any aspect; inner content sits in a centered max-width column. Vertical slack is absorbed by flex spacers (with caps) and the photo band, so each size fills its canvas exactly without stretching anything.

**Verified programmatically** (headless measurement pass on all three sizes):
- No element crosses the viewport bounds; no clipped/scrolling text; `scrollHeight` == canvas height exactly (1350 / 1000 / 600).
- Candidate column centers are symmetric and evenly spaced: 276/540/804, 375.6/600/824.4, 76.1/150/223.9.
- Headline block height 129.6 / 110.2 / 36.3 px = exactly 1 : 0.85 : 0.28.
- Photo uses `object-fit: cover` with `object-position: 32% 58%`, so it crops (keeping the farmhouse and sun) instead of distorting — band aspect goes from 4.5:1 down to 1.16:1 with no stretch.
- Inter loads via `@font-face` (variable, weights 100–900) and `document.fonts.check` passes before capture.

Fixes made after the first pass: steps are now a single left-aligned group (icons line up instead of a ragged centered stack), and `justify-content: space-between` removed a dead ~50px white gap at the bottom of the sky version.
